trust_decision.summary: Decided once, at every point where an untrusted repo name / workspace / project dir is joined into a filesystem path: it must stay inside the managed directories. The fix hardens the two path builders (repoPullDir, cloneDir) and the eight WorkingDir entry points, adds a shared utils.EnsureSubPath bound check, drops '..'/absolute/slash workspace at the atlantis.yaml schema, and drops '..' repo names at the shared Repo constructor.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'Workspace Handling ... Out-of-Bounds Directory Deletion/Creation'; repoPullDir/cloneDir is where the repo name and workspace become an absolute path, and Delete/DeleteForWorkspace (working_dir.go:803-814) pass that path straight to os.RemoveAll. Every reader starts here.

fix_sites.entry_point: repo-level atlantis.yaml parse (server/core/config/parser_validator.go:100-104 Validate before ToValid), reached from POST /events and from server-side --repo-config at startup
models.NewRepo public Go API, called by every VCS event parser (server/events/event_parser.go:377-1087) behind POST /events
POST /events issue_comment policy_check (also plan/apply); project dir joined onto the clone dir
events.WorkingDir.GetWorkingDir public Go API, used by doApply/doVersion/doPolicyCheck and project_command_builder.go:849
events.WorkingDir.GetPullDir public Go API, used by plan_command_runner.go:388 and project_command_builder.go:837
events.WorkingDir.DeleteForWorkspace public Go API (os.RemoveAll of the workspace dir)
shared builder used by all of the above (repo name + PR number + workspace)
existing containment helper now fed by the hardened repoPullDir/cloneDir
DELETE /locks unlock -> delete_lock_command.go:39 -> DeletePlan; also doPlan stale-plan cleanup at project_command_runner.go:716
GitReadLock acquired around every plan/apply step run (project_command_runner.go:922)
none (new shared helper server/utils/filepath.go EnsureSubPath consumed by the sites above)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue repo names are already gated by ATLANTIS_REPO_ALLOWLIST plus the existing '/' checks at models.go:160-167 and the clone dir is already proven inside the data dir by validateCloneDir (working_dir.go:828-835), so the model constructor and the other WorkingDir methods are 'already covered' and need no change.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: GitLab subgroup owners, Azure DevOps team projects and Bitbucket Cloud names legitimately contain '/' and spaces in the repo full name; the existing '/' allowances at models.go:160-167 and models_test.go:61 must keep working, so an over-broad 'sanitize the repo name' fix breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: workspace with embedded directory separator (sub/dir) and backslash (sub\dir)
repo full name whose owner carries '..' (GitLab subgroup 'group/subgroup/../../etc/repo') and whose repo segment carries '..' (owner/repo..)
project dir relative paths '../etc', '../../../../etc', 'sub/../../etc' reaching filepath.Join(repoDir, RepoRelDir)
paths that clean to inside the base must stay allowed; '/data/repos-evil' style prefix matches must be rejected

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/plan and POST /api/apply take Paths[].Directory and Paths[].Workspace straight from the JSON body and forward them as RepoRelDir/Workspace after only strings.TrimRight(dir, "/") — no '..' check, and the repo-config workspace check is skipped entirely when the dir has no configured project
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the HTTP API is token-authenticated operator tooling, so its Paths fields are trusted, and the downstream sink checks cover whatever it sends
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: server/controllers (HTTP layer), two packages away from working_dir; not named in the report

O8_uncovered_routes.route: plan file path is built as filepath.Join(projectAbsPath, runtime.GetPlanFilename(ctx.Workspace, ...)) and written with os.WriteFile (remote ops) or read for apply; GetPlanFilename sanitizes '/' in the project name but not the workspace, so a workspace the guarded project-dir check never sees still escapes the clone dir
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the workspace is a Terraform workspace name rather than a path, and it is now validated when the atlantis.yaml is loaded, so the plan filename cannot traverse
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: server/core/runtime, six step-runner files in another package from both the landing point and the changed command runners

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second plan/show/planfile path builder (apply_step_runner.go:36, import_step_runner.go:47, state_rm_step_runner.go:47, show_step_runner.go:46, run_step_runner.go:72) that repeats the unchecked Join
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: each command has its own runner file and its own copy of the planfile Join; a maintainer adding one more command naturally copies the line without any bound check

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third hand-rolled containment check (filepath.Rel + '..' prefix test) next to the new EnsureSubPath
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this file already solved the same containment problem before the advisory; a new 'delete plans for workspace' helper would plausibly re-implement this local check rather than call the new helper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: third WorkingDir implementation overriding GetWorkingDir/DeletePlan instead of only Clone/MergeAgain
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the wrapper already overrides two methods and embeds the rest; a new token-refresh method for another construct is the obvious place to forget the bound check

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new workspace-scoped helper on FileWorkspace (e.g. untracked-files or plan lookup) that takes workspace and joins it itself
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GetGitUntrackedFiles is the template: it takes a repo/pull/workspace and is only safe because it delegates to GetWorkingDir

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another API request field or endpoint (state rm, import, version) forwarding a directory/workspace
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the API mirrors the comment commands field by field, so a new endpoint copies the same unvalidated Paths struct

O9_family: path traversal / uncontrolled path expression (CWE-22, CWE-73)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.4 (go.mod:3), standard go build/test, pegomock-generated mocks committed
O10_build.project_tests: server/events/working_dir_test.go (local git repos via t.TempDir), server/events/project_command_runner_test.go, server/core/config/raw/project_test.go, server/events/models/models_test.go, server/core/runtime/*_step_runner_test.go — all offline unit tests, no VCS or network needed

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject or strip '..' in the workspace name at the comment parser / cloneDir only, which clears the reproduction while repo names, the api Paths inputs, the /api plan filename path and the project dir joins in the six command runners stay open.

out_of_scope_notes: The /apply/lock, /apply/unlock and /github-app/* routes (server/server.go:1118-1120, 1105-1106) do not touch the workspace path sink; not pursued.
